reviewer: Independent Codex visual review (exact model identifier unavailable)
scope: Saved final-run-01 image-01..image-12 and chart-01..chart-07 only; 19 synthetic PDF questions
method: Read each saved question, reference, generated answer and citation; visually inspected all four original pages of each PDF. Correctness grades the user-facing answer, not merely whether the cited page contains the answer. Faithfulness requires material claims to follow from cited original pages; a citation to an unrelated page reduces citation support. Scores are bounded human-style review by a distinct Codex assistant, not a validated RAGAS score or a production accuracy estimate.

scale.answer_correctness: 1 complete and accurate; 0.5 partial or indirect; 0 wrong, omitted, or false refusal
scale.faithfulness: 1 all material claims supported by cited original evidence; 0.5 mixed; 0 unsupported; null for no substantive answer
scale.answer_relevancy: 1 direct; 0.5 partial or indirect; 0 irrelevant; null for appropriate negative abstention
scale.hallucination: true explicit unsupported factual claim; false supported, qualified or abstained; null evidence unavailable

limitations: Only one saved final run and 19 synthetic visual questions; no independent replay or real household documents.
Faithfulness uses original cited PDF pages, which can contain more information than the exact OCR chunk text shown in citations.
Rubric is a bounded Codex review without inter-rater calibration or external judge credential.
No scanned-PDF generation responses were saved in this run; scanned answer correctness is not measured here.
